en.t: Yugiri felt as though he were in a dream.

units.source_text: 如今大愿遂成，他觉得自身更可尊贵了。

en.t: Now that his great wish had finally been fulfilled, he felt himself even more exalted.

units.source_text: 云居雁不胜羞涩，沉思不语。

en.t: Kumoi no Kari was overcome with shyness and sat lost in thought, saying nothing.

units.source_text: 但见夕雾成年后比从前更加俊秀，真乃美玉无瑕。

en.t: Yet she saw that Yugiri, now grown, was even more handsome than before, truly like a flawless jewel.

units.source_text: 夕雾向云居雁诉恨：“我身几乎做了世人的话柄。

en.t: Yugiri complained bitterly to Kumoi no Kari: "I nearly became the talk of the world.

units.source_text: 全靠专心一意，努力忍耐，终于获得了允许。

en.t: Only by keeping my heart fixed on one purpose and enduring with all my strength did I finally win permission.

units.source_text: 你却毫不关情，真乃异乎寻常。”

en.t: Yet you showed no concern at all; that is truly extraordinary."

units.source_text: 后来又说：“弁少将唱《苇垣》，你懂得他的意思么？

en.t: Later he said again, "When Ben no Shosho sang 'The Reed Fence,' did you understand what he meant?

units.source_text: 这个主人对我讽刺得好厉害！

en.t: Our host was cutting at me rather sharply!

units.source_text: 我想唱《河口》来报答他呢。”

en.t: I thought I might answer him by singing 'The River Mouth.'"

units.source_text: 云居雁觉得此歌难听，答以诗云：

en.t: Kumoi no Kari found the song unpleasant to hear and answered with this poem:
